scope: Read-only remote acquisition, read-only existing Git object reuse, and one new isolated Git combination.
retrieval_method: Approved GitHub GET connector; exact contents listing then immutable raw.githubusercontent.com URLs; every response rehashed to the listed Git blob and byte size.
package_recovery: Decode each files[name].gzip_base64 using strict base64, gzip-decompress; verify byte size, SHA256, and Git blob before using recovered files. Reject absolute/traversal member paths. No upstream script executed.
reproduction_dependency: Restore the immutable original PR168 evidence package and PR172 prior archive at the paths recorded in the script; recover the former's 33 authenticated gzip/base64 members. Use read-only Git object alternates containing the recorded commits and trees.
